verdict.rationale: Official docs explicitly list hardware plugin support for Google TPUs, Intel Gaudi, IBM Spyre, Huawei Ascend, and others alongside GPUs/CPUs, directly confirming the plugin architecture for specialized accelerators. However, there is no independent/hands-on community evidence corroborating TPU or Gaudi inference in practice, and no detail on setup, performance parity, or limitations of these plugins. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of TPU or Gaudi usage, documentation depth on plugin installation/configuration, and performance benchmarks on these accelerators.
